_about: The register of open items (Core Part 12, item 39; after APE-311): every item the record keeps OPEN, with what it needs, who can close it, the condition under which it closes and the avenue it belongs to. A Navigator does not close an item by constructing a plausible answer, and a study not yet run is not replaced by a forecast of its result (Core L-531 (3)). Checked by python3 tools/open_register.py --check, in CI.
